verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any multi-account or project isolation pattern, such as management groups, landing zones, sandbox subscriptions or policy guardrails. RBAC access scoping and budget alerts are adjacent controls and are not documented isolation patterns for keeping experiments away from production. The axis clearly applies to a cloud platform, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, experiments cannot hurt prod — documented multi-account/project isolation patterns (org units, sandboxes) with guardrails
